notes.title: Return to Monkey Island gets a GOG release
notes.notes: Fans of GOG and adventure games will be happy, as the new Return to Monkey Island is now available on GOG.Read the full article here: https://www.gamingonlinux.com/2022/11/return-to-monkey-island-gets-a-gog-release

notes.title: Patch Notes 1.5
notes.notes:
Hello everyone, Today we have some amazing things to share with you!

We added German voice-over to the game featuring original Guybrush voice actor Norman Matt!

In addition to that, there were some minor bug fixes

notes.title: Patch Notes 1.3.3
notes.notes:
Hello everyone! New patch is here!


 Trivia card fix for players that couldn’t get the last card.
 Fixed a key rebinding issue relating to the middle mouse button

notes.title: Patch Notes 1.3.2
notes.notes:
Hello everyone! Got a new patch with new fixes check it down bellow! 


 Possible for fix for mouse events when using a controller.
 Fix for red flash on MacBook Pro 13 inch.
Set pref: metalCompatibilityFloat16ColorBuffer: 1
 Changed graphics card support message.
 Offline Steam achievements.
 Small game bug fixes.
 Fixes for Translation typos and other text.

notes.title: Patch notes 1.3.1
notes.notes:
Hello! We are continuing with bug fixes!


 Fixed sleeping Windows and a controller.
 Performance and stability improvements on low-end machines.
 Minor bug fixes.



Have an amazing day and thank you for your patience and understanding!

notes.title: Patch notes 1.2
notes.notes:
Hello! Here is a small patch to fix some of the issues that you encountered on release. We are still going through reports and working on fixing them all out! 


 Fixed sleeping Windows and a controller.
 Performance and stability improvements on low-end machines.
 Minor bug fixes.


Thank you for your patience and understanding!
